decisions.nm: Rattigan v. Chief Immigration Officer
decisions.pe: Zimbabwean women married to foreign men found their husbands could not get residence. The Supreme Court said a woman’s right to live in her country includes living there with her husband.
decisions.pi: Perempuan Zimbabwe yang menikah dengan pria asing mendapati suami mereka tidak bisa mendapat izin tinggal. MA menyatakan hak perempuan tinggal di negaranya termasuk tinggal bersama suaminya.

decisions.nm: Zimbabwe Lawyers for Human Rights and IHRDA (on behalf of Andrew Meldrum) v. Zimbabwe
decisions.ct: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.pe: A US journalist who had lived and worked in Zimbabwe for over 20 years was deported even though courts had ordered that he could stay. The African Commission found a breach.
decisions.pi: Seorang wartawan AS yang tinggal dan bekerja di Zimbabwe lebih dari 20 tahun dideportasi padahal pengadilan sudah memerintahkan ia boleh tinggal. Komisi Afrika menemukan pelanggaran.

decisions.nm: Salem v. Chief Immigration Officer
decisions.pe: Right of a citizen wife’s foreign husband to reside and work.
decisions.pi: Hak suami asing dari istri warga negara untuk tinggal dan bekerja.

decisions.nm: Zimbabwe Lawyers For Human Rights and Another v. Republic of Zimbabwe
decisions.ct: African Commission on Human and Peoples Rights
decisions.pe: Expulsion of a foreign journalist from Zimbabwe.
decisions.pi: Pengusiran seorang jurnalis asing dari Zimbabwe.
